decision_reason: Required by LS-VERIFY.1 (bead-wide) and LS-INVARIANT.1: moon run :lint-src must exit 0 with zero #[allow(unreachable_pub)] suppressions surviving and zero unreachable_pub warnings firing. Covers all 25 attribute-removal rows because the lint-src gate is the canonical enforcement point for the workspace.lints.rust unreachable_pub = "deny" policy at Cargo.toml:57. Single-pass gate that catches all category A/B/C/D/E/F/G failures uniformly.

Required because categories B/C/D narrow pub fn to fn (and pub to pub(crate)), which can break sibling-module direct-path imports if the Rust 2021+ visibility rule is misapplied. cargo check --workspace --all-features exits 0 iff every narrowed visibility compiles. Compile-check is faster than full cargo test and isolates compile errors from test-logic errors. Covers PS-001..018 because the gate is workspace-wide.

Required by LS-VERIFY.2: cargo test --workspace must exit 0 with same test count as pre-change baseline. Covers all categories that touch test code: vestigial-allow removals (A.2-4 include in-file tests), gate-internal narrowings (B.1-7 touch gate_tests.rs and gate_XX/tests.rs), taint/type/secret-leak narrowings (C.1-3 touch in-file tests and tests.rs), schema-support narrowings (D.1-4 touch schema_tests.rs and schema_fields/*.rs), diag (E.2-3 touch diag_tests.rs and diag_render/render_tests.rs), lifecycle (G.touch lifecycle_integration.rs). Excludes E.1 (diag_codes decision — no test code) and G.1/G.2 (orphan test, see PO-DECISION-001).

Required for categories E and F: every pub item the bead intends to keep pub MUST be confirmed externally reachable via downstream-crate path or registered integration test. The grep must be performed PRE-ApplyTreatment (before visibility changes) because the externality analysis depends on the pre-change symbol surface. Covers: LS-DIAG.1 (diag_codes 60+ constants), LS-DIAG.3 (diagnostic_from_error, error_code), LS-REEXPORT.1 (diagnostic.rs re-exports), LS-LIFECYCLE.1 (create_run_header), and LS-VERIFY.3 (verus-production-binding gate). Forbidden in spec: must NOT remove allow from items that are externally reachable (decisions G) — this grep is the structural guard against that failure mode.

Required by LS-VERIFY.3 to defend H7 (production-binding drift): the existing scripts/check-verus-production-binding.sh gate verifies Verus spec bindings remain STRONG (#[path=...]) or WEAK_MIRROR (production_inner/*) and not broken by visibility changes. Specifically relevant for category G.2 IncidentReport: the Verus extern_*.rs bindings reference production::Kind::IncidentReport enum variant, NOT the local commands_incident::IncidentReport struct; the gate confirms this independence. Pair with check-production-inner-drift.sh to catch mirror drift.

Required by LS-ORPHAN.2 pre-condition: the production_inner mirror must be independent of commands_incident::IncidentReport visibility. check-production-inner-drift.sh enforces zero drift between production_inner/*.rs and the production source; if the bead accidentally references the local IncidentReport type from production_inner, the drift gate fails closed. Companion gate to check-verus-production-binding.sh.

Required pre-condition for category G: the orphan test vb_test_cli_diff_incident_behavior.rs (646 lines, NOT registered in any Cargo.toml, only metadata ref is source-length-exceptions.txt:221 vb-jpq7.47 split-or-retire-before-release) must be retired or registered BEFORE ApplyTreatment fires for commands_diff.rs and commands_incident.rs. Default is RetireOrphanTest (per codebase-map.md Open Questions recommendation 1). The decision-ack.md artifact is a single-file decision record: RetireOrphanTest or RegisterOrphanTest, with rationale. Spec forbids removing allow from externally reachable items (decisions G) — this decision-ack is the structural guard.

Required pre-condition for category G.2 narrowing commands_incident::IncidentReport: grep -R 'IncidentReport' verification/verus/production_inner/ must return no results, confirming the Verus production_inner mirror does not directly consume the local IncidentReport struct. This is the structural guard against breaking the Verus spec binding when the local visibility changes.

The check-verus-production-binding gate (LD-vb-7akm0-005) covers the binding health check. No new Verus obligations are created.
